newsitem.title: USA: Payless Cashways Jan same-store sales off.
newsitem.headline: Payless Cashways Jan same-store sales off.

text.p: Payless Cashways Inc said Thursday its comparable store sales for the month of January decreased 0.3 percent.
The building materials retailer said total sales fell 2.2 percent to $143.33 million from $146.63 million for the four-week sales period ended February 1, 1997.
For its fiscal year to date, same-store sales were down 4.5 percent and total sales fell 7.7 percent to $331.71 million from $359.50 million.
The company said that because of the 53-week reporting basis for 1996, January is not on a comparable calendar basis. Also, January 1997 has one more sales day.

If presented on a comparable calendar basis, Payless said monthly total sales would have decreased 5.6 percent and same-store sales would have fallen 3.8 percent. Year-to-date, total sales would have decreased 4.2 percent while same-store sales would have declined 1.2 percent.
